description: Search and count individual 3D equipment models in the DualSoft Public 3D Library (/ui/library/), returning modelCount, industrial category totals, usage rights, and SHA-256 pinned viewer/GLB/ZIP/DS2 links (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless). Filter with optional q (equivalent aliases: query, search, keyword) and category, and paginate with limit (default 20, clamped to 1..200) and offset/page; public responses are subject to rate limits. Use to find equipment IDs before inspecting one model with dsdx.library.get; use dsdx.scene.catalog instead only for provider-level 3D catalog diagnostics.

category.description: Optional industrial category filter (e.g. 'A 공통 자동화와 가공', 'B 이송 물류와 포장', 'E 자동차모빌리티', 'L 반도체'; call with {} first to view all categories and counts)

limit.description: Maximum items to return in items[] (1..200, default: 20; values above 200 are clamped to 200; modelCount and total always report the full count)

offset.description: Pagination offset into matching items (0..10000, default: 0)

page.description: Optional 1-based page number shorthand for offset = (page - 1) * limit when offset is omitted

q.description: Optional equipment keyword query (e.g. '로봇', '컨베이어', 'clamp', 'turntable'); omit or '' to count and list all approved 3D models

name: dsdx.library.search

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
